classification.classification_reason: The article is about the first mission failure of United Launch Alliance's Vulcan rocket, which is a key player in the space launch industry.

content.title: United Launch Alliance's First Mission Failure
content.caption: United Launch Alliance's Vulcan rocket suffered its first mission failure, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites.

slides.heading: United Launch Alliance's First Mission Failure
slides.text: United Launch Alliance's Vulcan rocket suffered its first mission failure, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites.

slides.heading: The Launch
slides.text: The launch was supposed to be the first of 38 flights Amazon purchased from United Launch Alliance, but it failed to deliver the Amazon mission to orbit.

slides.heading: The Anomaly
slides.text: Based on data received by the Launch Director, United Launch Alliance confirmed that the Vulcan vehicle suffered an anomaly 10 minutes into the flight and failed to deliver the Amazon mission to orbit.
